title: BMW Sales Executive
description:
BMW SALES EXECUTIVE.

Earn up to £60,000 OTE per annum plus a Company Car!

WHY WORK FOR HEDIN AUTOMOTIVE BMW & MINI.

Join the Hedin Automotive sales team as a BMW Sales Executive and help customers find their perfect BMW while delivering an exceptional buying experience. You'll represent one of the world's leading premium automotive brands, guiding customers through every stage of their journey, from their initial enquiry through to vehicle handover. With access to the latest BMW models, innovative technology, and ongoing manufacturer training, you'll have everything you need to build a rewarding career in automotive sales.

BENEFITS.

Hedin Automotive values our employees and invests in personal development and training. In addition, we offer a wide range of market-leading benefits to all our colleagues.
- 31 days of annual leave (including bank holidays) with long-service awards and enhanced holiday entitlement
- Discount schemes with popular retailers - helping you save more
- Employee Car Ownership Schemes - available for you and your family
- Employee Assistance Programme - 24/7 wellbeing support with access to health professionals
- Private healthcare access - prioritising your health and prosperity
- Pension scheme and life assurance - confidence in your future
- Referral bonus - earn when you refer a friend to join the team

Why not take a moment to view all our benefits and see what our employees love about working at Hedin Automotive by visiting our

THE MAIN DUTIES OF THE ROLE INCLUDE:
- Guiding customers through the complete sales journey, from initial enquiry and test drive through to finance, accessories, and vehicle handover
- Providing expert advice across the full range of new and approved used BMW models
- Identifying customer needs and delivering tailored solutions while achieving individual sales targets
- Proactively building relationships with new and existing customers to generate repeat business and referrals
- Assisting customers with vehicle configuration, finance options, and part-exchange valuations
- Negotiating sales professionally while ensuring an outstanding customer experience
- Accurately processing sales contracts, vehicle orders, and finance documentation
- Acting as a brand ambassador for BMW and maintaining exceptional product knowledge

YOUR PROFILE.
- Strong communication, influencing, and negotiation skills to close sales
- Highly motivated with a passion for achieving and exceeding sales targets
- Enjoy following processes, handling administration, and working under pressure
- Well-organised with excellent diary management and timely follow-ups
- Skilled at building rapport, earning trust, and resolving conflicts calmly.
- Enthusiastic about customer service, professional, and well-presented
- Proven Sales experience in the automotive industry preferred.

SALARY AND WORKING HOURS.
- Basic salary of £23,000 per annum with a competitive OTE of £50,000-£60,000, with a Company Car
- Monday to Friday, 8:30am - 6pm with a day off during the week, plus every Saturday, 8:30am to 5pm (41.5 hours per week). Additionally, will be required to work Sundays on a rota basis (1 in 15).

ABOUT US.

Hedin Automotive is a well-established BMW & MINI franchise with state-of-the-art centres across North London, East London, and Kent.

As part of Hedin Mobility Group-one of the world's leading private automotive retail and aftermarket services providers we are dedicated to excellence in everything we do. Whether in customer-facing roles or the workshop, our incredible teams are passionate about making Hedin Automotive a seamless, enjoyable place to do business. We strive to create great experiences through a team that genuinely cares about our customers.

Click apply today and take the first step towards a rewarding career in the automotive industry.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive

An exciting opportunity for a Business Development Executive to join a top-tier global law firm. Working closely with the BD Manager and Partners, you'll play a key role in delivering the firm's business development and marketing strategy, supporting client development initiatives, campaigns, events and profile-raising activities while building strong relationships with stakeholders across the business.

What's On Offer:
- Salary to £46,000
- 09:30-17:30 working hours and hybrid working of 50% office based per week
- Stunning offices and sought-after City location

Business Development Executive - What You'll Be Doing:

You will help drive initiatives across profile building, client retention and development, new client targeting, and sector growth.

This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with other specialist teams, including Marketing, Digital, Communications, PR, Events, CRM, Client Services, Bids, and Responsible Business. The successful candidate will focus on maintaining client relationships, preparing tailored pitch documents, ensuring accurate client data in the CRM system, and supporting the planning and delivery of sector-specific campaigns, events, and thought leadership initiatives.

Business Development Executive - What We're Looking For:

The ideal candidate must be willing to travel to other UK-based offices when required, have a minimum of 2 years' experience of broad-ranging marketing roles, preferably within the legal or real estate sectors, as well as possess a bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, or a related field.

A client focused mindset and a strong collaborator will excel in this role.

For further information, please contact Neil Hagan.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive - Construction Property Professional Indemnity

Overview:

As a Business Development Executive, you will proactively engage with mid-market and SME businesses across the UK, with a particular focus on clients within the construction and property professional services sector. This includes organisations such as surveyors, architects, design and planning consultancies, and engineering firms across all disciplines. You will help clients understand how you / our client can support their insurance needs, gaining valuable experience in identifying risk exposures, discussing tailored insurance solutions, and promoting end-to-end service-from initial consultation through to long-term partnership.

Your role will be central to expanding our clients client base and supporting our mission to deliver exceptional, specialist-led insurance solutions. Whether you are advising a local professional practice or supporting the placement of more complex programmes for growing and internationally active firms, your contribution will play a key role in driving continued growth.

Responsibilities:

Proactively contact prospective clients to introduce, gather relevant insurance information, and support negotiations with both clients and insurers.

Identify, research, and develop new sources of prospective clients to help expand presence and market reach.

Work closely with brokers and account handlers to support the onboarding and development of potential new clients.

Accurately maintain client and prospect records on our CRM systems, ensuring all information is recorded promptly and kept up to date in line with company standards.

Build a strong foundation of Professional Indemnity Insurance knowledge, including working towards and achieving CII insurance qualifications.

Actively participate in structured training and development programmes focused on building the core skills required for success in the role.

Contribute as part of a fast-paced, collaborative, and continually evolving environment, with significant opportunities for learning and professional growth.

Requirements:

Previous experience within the insurance market and sales.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Our clients team thrives on effective communication and the ability to work together towards common goals.

Sales and negotiation skills that will help you compete in a fast-paced market.

Strong motivation and ambition in progressing your career in insurance.

An eye for detail to ensure that all records and client interactions are meticulously managed and maintained.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
A leading global law firm is seeking a Business Development Executive to join its London-based Marketing & Business Development team, supporting its Real Estate, Tax and Employment practices across the EMEA region.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious BD professional to gain broad exposure to strategic, client-facing and profile-raising activity while working closely with partners, senior stakeholders and colleagues across the global business.

The Role

The Business Development Executive will support the delivery of business development and marketing strategies, including:
- Developing bids, pitches, credentials, presentations and client-facing content
- Supporting business plans, campaigns, client development and profile-raising initiatives
- Coordinating events, directory submissions and award entries
- Managing and maintaining marketing materials and budgets, including ROI reporting
- Building strong relationships with partners, lawyers and internal stakeholders
- Collaborating with specialist teams across BD, bids, events, design, digital and marketing services
- Sharing best practice and contributing to wider EMEA and global initiatives

About You

The ideal candidate will be a graduate-calibre BD or marketing professional with:
- Experience in business development, marketing or communications, ideally within legal or professional services
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills and strong attention to detail
- Experience writing bids, pitches or sales-focused content is advantageous
- Strong organisation and the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders
- A proactive, collaborative and commercially minded approach
- Confidence to take ownership and build relationships with senior stakeholders
- A relevant professional qualification, such as CIM, is desirable

Why Join?

The role offers excellent exposure to strategic business development, partner engagement and international collaboration, providing a strong platform for career progression within a high-performing global professional services environment.

The firm is committed to diversity, inclusion, flexible working and employee wellbeing, creating an environment where people can develop, collaborate and achieve their full potential.

If this job isn't quite right for you, but you know someone who would be great at this role, why not take advantage of our referral scheme? We offer £200 in shopping vouchers for every referred candidate who we place in a role. Terms & Conditions Apply.

title: COMMERCIAL INSURANCE SALES ADVISOR
description:
Hybrid working. Clark James Insurance Recruitment are working with a fantastic and unique Insurance broker in the Croydon area with a modern office, great training and prospects and a lovely team to work with.

They are looking to recruit experienced Commercial account handlers/sales advisors to help manage both existing and new business client relationships.

The majority of clients are commercial SME You should have at least a year's general insurance experience and ideally have used Acturis but this is not essential. You should also have an up to date knowledge of Financial Conduct Authority requirements including Treating Customers Fairly and an understanding of the UK Insurance market.

The role:

Apply today in strict confidence for more details if you can commute to Croydon 3 days a week and have the relevant UK Insurance experience.

title: Delegate Sales Representative
description:
Nicholas Howard are delighted to be recruiting for a Delegate Sales Representative.

As Delegate Sales Representative, you'll drive delegate revenue through consultative sales and outbound partnerships, owning relationships with VIPs and senior stakeholders from first conversation to on-site experience. You'll play a key role in curating high-value audiences, creating meaningful peer-to-peer networking, and ensuring every event delivers exceptional value-for our delegates and our partners.

About the Role

As a Delegate Sales Representative you will:
- Build and maintain a focused target account list in collaboration with Conference Producers, using LinkedIn, company research, and industry news.
- Source, qualify, and nurture leads through the sales funnel, ensuring accurate Salesforce CRM upkeep.
- Re-engage past delegates and speaker contacts to drive repeat attendance.
- Develop and execute a VIP acquisition and nurturing plan aligned with event milestones, supported by the Sector Head and Head of Delegate Sales.
- Send personalized invitations, manage RSVPs, and ensure high-value onsite engagement and networking.
- Maintain ongoing relationships with VIPs and industry groups to enhance delegate experience and retention.
- Collaborate with marketing and commercial teams to identify attendee growth areas and optimize outbound focus based on booking patterns.
- Provide insights into industry challenges and investment trends to support onsite sponsor introductions and strategic networking.
- Manage face-to-face VIP engagement during events, ensuring meaningful interactions with sponsors and other stakeholders.
- Follow through on nurture processes to secure attendance and post-event relationship continuity.

About You

You will likely have:
- Previous outbound B2 B sales experience in an events environment.
- Proven track record of engaging with C-level executives and senior decision makers.
- Partnership development experience with focus on relationship building and lead conversion.
- Outbound prospecting expertise across multiple channels (LinkedIn, email, phone, referrals).
- Lead qualification and nurturing capabilities.
- Pipeline management and revenue forecasting.
- Cross-functional collaboration abilities (working with marketing, sales teams, content teams).
- Event industry experience preferred, with understanding of delegate/attendee acquisition.
- CRM and data management experience preferred (specifically Salesforce).

Should you wish to be considered for this position, please apply below.

title: Personal Lines Sales Executive
description:
Personal Lines Sales Executive
Tolworth £26,500-£28,500 basic + bonus potential taking earnings to £40,000 + £2,300 annual Saturday allowance
Hybrid working: one week in the office, followed by three weeks from home after initial training

Have experience selling car or van insurance and want a role where you can earn more, enjoy greater flexibility and develop your insurance career?

CKB Recruitment is working with an established insurance intermediary to recruit a Personal Lines Sales Executive for its growing Tolworth team.

With over 40 years' experience in the insurance market, this business offers the support of an experienced team, funding for professional qualifications and a generous commission scheme. There's also free on-site parking and a free staff gym.

The opportunity

You'll handle inbound enquiries from new and existing customers looking for motor and home insurance, helping them find suitable cover and turning enquiries into sales.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Speaking with customers to understand their insurance requirements.
- Providing quotations and arranging suitable car, van and home insurance.
- Converting inbound enquiries into sales while delivering a professional, helpful service.
- Liaising with insurers where required.
- Maintaining accurate customer records and completing supporting administration.

What we're looking for

You'll need previous personal lines insurance sales experience, particularly in car and van insurance. Home insurance knowledge would also be useful.

You'll be confident speaking with customers, motivated by sales and committed to providing a high standard of service. A professional approach and the drive to develop your career will be key.

If you're already working towards your CII qualification, that's a bonus-but it isn't essential. The business can help fund your professional studies.

Salary, benefits and working pattern
- £26,500-£28,500 basic salary, depending on experience.
- Commission/bonus potential taking earnings to £40,000.
- An additional £2,300 per year for working alternate Saturdays.
- One week in the office followed by three weeks working from home.
- Support with professional qualifications.
- Free on-site staff gym and parking.

The office is on Hook Rise South, Tolworth, beside the A3. Your first three months will be fully office-based for training, before moving to the hybrid pattern.

Working hours are Monday to Friday, 9am-6pm, plus alternate Saturdays, 9am-4.30pm.

To find out more, apply today or contact Lesley Bordon at CKB Recruitment - General Insurance & Financial Services Recruitment for a confidential conversation.

title: Senior Business Development Executive
description:
A leading international professional services firm is seeking a Senior Business Development Executive to support growth within its Life Sciences & Healthcare sector on a 15-month fixed-term contract. Based in Bristol or London, with hybrid working.

The role will partner closely with senior lawyers and marketing colleagues to drive client development, new business, cross-selling and sector profile. Responsibilities include:
- Managing business development initiatives, pipelines, budgets and performance reporting.
- Supporting key client accounts, including client mapping and relationship plans.
- Taking ownership of a key client relationship and supporting wider account activity.
- Delivering targeted events, campaigns and follow-up activity with a focus on ROI.
- Producing and repurposing marketing and communications content across multiple channels.
- Managing pitches, credentials, legal directory and award submissions.
- Using revenue, margin and campaign data to identify opportunities and improve performance.
- Supervising junior team members on selected projects.

The successful candidate will bring proven business development or marketing experience within Life Sciences & Healthcare, ideally gained in legal or professional services. They will be highly organised, commercially minded and confident working with senior stakeholders.

Strong project management, communication and analytical skills are essential, alongside experience of CRM systems and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. A proactive, creative and client-focused approach, combined with curiosity about the sector and an ability to spot commercial opportunities, will be key to success.

title: Account Manager
description:
The Role

As an Account Manager in the Corporate Accounts team, you will be responsible for the overall growth of revenue from existing customer accounts. You will be required to drive cross-selling and up-selling activity within the portfolio, whilst minimising revenue churn across all accounts under your management. Acting as the main point of contact for customers through all growth-related conversations and activities, you will be accountable for ensuring excellent customer experience across the end-to-end lead to order process, coordinating inputs from other teams and functions as required.

Key Responsibilities
- Drive revenue growth across accounts under management through cross-selling of the portfolio
- Reduce revenue churn in accounts under management
- Operate with a CX first mindset, putting customer outcomes at the heart of how you operate
- Work closely with the Head of Corporate Accounts and Sales Engineering on account development plans
- Collaborate with the Marketing team on account-based marketing
- Engage proactively with Sales Specialists to align on solution positioning, ensure technical feasibility and drive value-led conversations with customers
- Partner with the Bid Management team to progress bid activity for growth opportunities identified

Skills and Attributes
- Flexible and creative to take considered risks
- Learn and adapt quickly to changing situations
- Self-motivated and able to work under pressure
- Ability to travel to different sites and locations on a weekly basis
- Manages conflict and challenges in an open and constructive manner
- You will have the knowledge and experience to carry out complex tasks competently, confidently and consistently
- Demonstrable success in driving revenue growth and developing cross-sell and up-sell opportunities
- Strong relationship management skills, with proven success delivering excellent customer experience
- Knowledge of relevant industries and market trends, with the ability to stay up-to-date on the latest developments

Benefits

At Claranet, we go the extra mile with our people-because we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. Our flexible benefits package includes:
- Pension Scheme: Employer-matched contributions to help you plan for the future.
- Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage: Access to private medical care for your peace of mind and wellbeing.
- Discounted Gym Memberships: Prioritise your fitness with exclusive rates at leading gyms.
- Personalised Wellbeing Support: App-based resources and services available 24/7
- Enhanced Annual Leave: 25 days of holiday, increasing to 27 days with service, plus bank holidays and a day off for your birthday.
- Continuous Learning & Development: Ongoing opportunities to grow your skills and advance your career.

What makes us unique is Team Claranet, our internal community that supports causes close to our employees' hearts. We offer paid charity leave, support local charities across our offices, and host annual fundraising events, all backed by a dedicated committee.

We're proud founding members of TC4 RE (Technology Community for Racial Equality) working collectively to build a more diverse and inclusive tech industry.

About Claranet

Founded at the beginning of the dot com bubble in 1996, our CEO Charles Nasser had a light bulb moment to develop a truly customer-focused IT business. Since then, Claranet has grown from an Internet Service Provider (ISP) in the UK to being one of the leading business modernisation experts, who deliver solutions across 11+ countries.

Equal Opportunities Statement

Diversity, equity and inclusion are at the heart of what we value as an organisation. Claranet is an equal opportunities employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other status protected by law. Our recruitment team are happy to support any reasonable adjustments that are needed within the recruitment process.

Ready to take the next step in your career with Claranet? Click 'apply' - we can't wait to meet you!

This is a newly created role for an ambitious Junior Account Manager who is keen to build on their existing account management experience, get closer to some of the biggest names in fashion, and really make their mark.
